column1: # BaseScreen batch: 26 real methods + 13 javac accessors used by ScreenInputProcessor.
# Touch state was resolved from ScreenInputProcessor: g/i are the touch-down flag and its
# expiry frame (h = the frame it was raised), j/l the same for touch-up (k = raised frame),
# and m/n hold the last touch x/y written by its touch handlers.
# Application forwarding was resolved from DesktopApplication: d() returns
# Locale.getDefault().getLanguage(), a(String) drives Desktop.Action.BROWSE, c() is
# Gdx.app.exit(), and a/b(int,int) add Mouse.getEventDX/DY with a 12px dead zone, i.e. the
# One row stays blank on purpose: y() forwards to GameApplication.h(), whose only
# implementation calls DesktopLauncher.a() with no observable meaning.
